title: How To Do 'THE HAND JIVE' | andreakswilson (HOW TO)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down choreography step-by-step with counts and builds up the speed gradually. She explains proper positioning and encourages practice.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the hand jive tutorial.
Breaks down part one: the hand jive hand movements.
Breaks down part two: Sandy and Danny step footwork and arm motions.

common_mistakes: going too fast or too slow on the count of eight

steps_taught.name: Hand Jive
steps_taught.description: Two thigh slaps, two claps, two arm crosses, two fist stacks, and two thumb hitches.

steps_taught.name: Sandy and Danny
steps_taught.description: Step together step with directional chest orientation and hand pointing.

what_works: breaking the dance into two parts
practicing slowly with counts before speeding up

quotes.text: It's really important that you count this because if you're going too fast...
Think of each move as a different number on the count of eight.
They're doing a step together step, step together step.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates hand jive positioning facing forward while explaining counts.

extraction.distinctive_method: Associating each arm movement with a distinct number in an 8-count sequence.
